name: Hammerheim — "loses all landwalk abilities" takes swampwalk
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). "Target creature loses all landwalk abilities" produced nothing (the keyword-loss parser skips anything with "all"). A family of keywords is now its own case: specificAbilities ["Landwalk"], which the engine matches against every "<land>walk" keyword. Bog Wraith loses swampwalk.
